To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the GmHsp17·5E promoter is differentially expressed in the flower and that it is transcriptionally inactive in pollen.
the expression pattern of the soybean GmHSP17.5E promoter in transgenic plants is complex, with some floral tissues and organs showing heat shock inducible GUS activity and others not.
the soybean heat shock protein promoter, Gm HSP 17· 5E, is not uniformly expressed in floral tissues and organs after a heat stress.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the expression of a gene encoding a small heat shock protein, HSP 17· 5, in floral tissues of transgenic soybean plants transformed with a GmHSP17·5E promoter/GUS fusion construct.
the expression of a small heat shock protein (sHSP) gene promoter in floral and vegetative tissues of soybean, and with the regulation of the promoter in pollen.
the identification of the genes involved in the heat shock response, the characterization of their expression patterns, and the identification of their roles.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the GmHSD 17·5 promoter is differentially expressed in all floral tissues.

heat shock inducible genes in general are not expressed in all organs and cells in the plant, even in a single species, and that the expression pattern of any particular gene may vary depending on the species or even on the organ in which it is being examined.
the GmHsp 17·5 promoter is differentially expressed in floral and reproductive structures in response to a heat shock and that the expression pattern is complex and tissue-specific.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the expression of this heat shock promoter is tissue specific and is not uniformly expressed in all floral and vegetative tissues and organs after a heat shock.

the GmHsp 17·5 gene is not expressed in pollen, but is expressed in the ovules, and that the expression of this gene in vegetative and floral tissues is not uniform, and varies as a function of the organ, stage of development and the heat treatment.
the GmHsp 17·5 gene is not a general stress response gene, but rather a gene that responds to a specific stress in a specific cell type in a tissue-specific manner.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the expression patterns of heat shock promoters are not uniform and that they are different in floral and vegetative tissues and that the expression patterns are complex in the pistil, ovules, and in anthers.
heat shock promoter activity is tissue and stage of development dependent.
the expression of the Gm HSP 17· 5E promoter is tissue specific, and that this tissue specificity is maintained after a heat shock.
